title: Amazon Share Price Trends Following Q2 Results
description: Investors are closely watching Amazon's share price after the company reported its second quarter results, showing growth in its cloud business.

sources.title: Amazon's AWS posts fastest growth since 2021, citing AI and chip demand

sections.heading: Amazon Q2 Results
paragraphs: Amazon has announced its second quarter results, which have been a significant factor in the recent movement of its share price, according to Amazon Investor Relations.

sections.heading: Cloud Revenue Growth
paragraphs: Reuters reports that Amazon has beaten estimates for its quarterly cloud revenue growth, which is a key driver for the company's financial performance.

sections.heading: AWS Growth
paragraphs: CNBC notes that Amazon's AWS has posted its fastest growth since 2021, attributing this to increased demand for AI and chips.

faq.q: What is the source of the Q2 results?
faq.a: The Q2 results were announced by Amazon Investor Relations.
AWS growth is significant because it indicates strong demand for Amazon's cloud services, which is a key revenue driver, as reported by CNBC.
